notes.title: The heights demo speedrunning
notes.notes:
The Heights

Are you ready to climb the heights?

The heights is a story based first-person single-player action shooter. Play as a time travelling robot and ascend to the top floor to save the future. Shoot and climb to the top of the skyscraper whilst avoiding assured death. Solve puzzles to proceed to the next floor. Destroy all research and eliminate the CEO to save the future from doom. All this whilst on a time loop that resets you after your death, or if you've outstayed your welcome.

Key Features
-Fine Tuned First Person Shooting
-Teleporting Gizmo lets you reach new places you normally wouldn't be allowed
-Fun and entertaining gameplay loop
-Fun and intuitive puzzles
-A good story
